arxiv-2104-10070.title: Cross-population coupling of neural activity based on Gaussian process current source densities
arxiv-2104-10070.creator: Natalie Klein
arxiv-2104-10070.description: Abstract Abstract Because local field potentials (LFPs) arise from multiple sources in different spatial locations, they do not easily reveal coordinated activity across neural populations on a trial-to-trial basis. As we show here, however, once disparate source signals are decoupled, their trial-to-trial fluctuations become more accessible, and cross-population correlations become more apparent.

arxiv-2306-13509.description: Abstract Assistive technologies and in particular assistive robotic arms have the potential to enable people with motor impairments to live a self-determined life. arxiv-2504-11752.title: Real-Time Reconstruction of Ground Motion During Small Magnitude Earthquakes: A Pilot Study
arxiv-2504-11752.creator: Youngkyu Kim, Qingkai Kong, Youngsoo Choi, Arben Pitarka, Byounghyun Yoo
arxiv-2504-11752.description: Abstract This study presents a pilot investigation into a novel method for reconstructing real-time ground motion during small magnitude earthquakes (M < 4.5), removing the need for computationally expensive source characterization and simulation processes to assess ground shaking. Small magnitude earthquakes, which occur frequently and can be modeled as point sources, provide ideal conditions for evaluating real-time reconstruction methods.

arxiv-2511-18753.title: Strain-induced Berry phase in chiral superconductors
arxiv-2511-18753.creator: Canon Sun, Marcel Franz, Joseph Maciejko
arxiv-2511-18753.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Canon Sun, Marcel Franz, Joseph Maciejko. We study the topology of the order parameter in the intermediate phase between the superconducting and time-reversal symmetry breaking transitions of a p x + i ​ p y p_{x}+ip_{y} superconductor under strain. The application of in-plane strain reduces the underlying crystal symmetry and lifts the degeneracy of the critical temperature between the p x p_{x} and p y p_{y} orbitals, resulting in a Dirac cone structure in the thermodynamic phase diagram.

pmc-12736498.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Turmeric (Curcuma longa) and its main bioactive compound curcumin are widely promoted for cardiometabolic health, yet their efficacy on lipid parameters remains uncertain.
